_comment: Castellan Farm ACTUAL tariff. plan='custom_tou' uses the explicit peak/mid/off hours and rates below (no seasonal variation). Switch plan to 'tou'/'ulo'/'flat' to use the Ontario RPP fields instead. After editing, re-run prepare_inputs.py.
name: Centre Wellington Hydro ULO + GS>50kW demand

custom_tou._hours_note: ULO-style evening on-peak 15:00-21:00 (6 h), mid 07:00-11:00 (4 h), off/overnight the remaining 14 h. Weekends off-peak. Rates = ULO commodity (2/9/27c, GA baked in) + ~2.5c/kWh delivery so the blended volumetric matches the 9.81c/kWh derived by regression from the actual Customer Activity Statement.

_demand_charge_note: Combined transmission + distribution demand charge, $/kW of monthly peak, DERIVED by regression (R^2=0.9994) from the actual Centre Wellington Hydro Customer Activity Statement (22 months). Demand charges are ~43% of the bill (~$17,800/yr).
